youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用的給小費情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從咖啡櫃台跳出的小費畫面、問店員到底要不要給、麵包店的現金小費罐，到外送員冒雨敲門、網約車下車前按螢幕、飯店房務每晚留幾塊、沙龍結帳時的服務費，最後和朋友對照各自給多少，不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Tipping at the Counter phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue) — a coffee screen that asks for a percent, the honest question at the counter, a bakery cash jar, a delivery driver in the rain, the rideshare tip before you open the door, a few bills for the hotel housekeeper, the salon service charge, and two friends comparing their numbers. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Morning! One medium coffee, please.
dialogue.zh: 早安！一杯中杯咖啡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hot, or with ice today?
dialogue.zh: 今天要熱飲還是加冰？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hot, please. My hands are frozen.
dialogue.zh: 熱的，拜託。我的手都凍僵了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sounds good. Black, or with milk?
dialogue.zh: 好。要黑咖啡還是加奶？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Black is fine today. No sugar.
dialogue.zh: 今天黑咖啡就好，不加糖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it. Name for the cup?
dialogue.zh: 了解。杯子上要寫什麼名字？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ben. B E N, that's it.
dialogue.zh: 班。B、E、N，就這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks, Ben. Card or cash here?
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，班。這裡刷卡還是付現金？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Card is faster. Let me tap.
dialogue.zh: 刷卡快一點，讓我按一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, just tap right on the circle.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr dʒʌst tæp raɪt ɑn ðə ˈsɜrkəl./
dialogue.zh: 好，直接碰那個圓圈就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did it work? The screen jumped.
dialogue.zh: 成功了嗎？畫面跳了一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it turned to face you now.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪt tɜrnd tə feɪs ju naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 對，它轉過來面向你了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: For me? What is this page?
dialogue.zh: 給我的？這一頁是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the tip screen, right there.
dialogue.zh: 那是小費畫面，就在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The tip screen? For one coffee?
dialogue.zh: 小費畫面？一杯咖啡也要？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yep, most folks tap something here.
dialogue.zh: 對，大多數人在這裡都會按一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These numbers aren't dollars, though.
dialogue.zh: 這些數字好像不是金額耶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They're percents of your coffee total.
dialogue.zh: 那是你那杯咖啡總價的百分比。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So twenty percent on four dollars?
dialogue.zh: 那就是四塊錢的百分之二十？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, four dollars, that's the first button.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs fɔr ˈdɑlərz ðæts ðə fɜrst ˈbʌtən./
dialogue.zh: 對，四塊錢，那是第一個按鈕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is the last one so big?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ ɪz ðə læst wʌn soʊ bɪɡ./
dialogue.zh: 為什麼最後那個比例這麼高？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's only a choice, not a rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈoʊnli ə tʃɔɪs nɑt ə rul./
dialogue.zh: 那只是一個選項，不是規定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a smaller button here?
dialogue.zh: 這裡有低一點的按鈕嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can tap custom and pick any.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn tæp ˈkəstəm ænd pɪk ˈɛni./
dialogue.zh: 你可以按自訂，自己選金額。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any amount? Even one dollar?
dialogue.zh: 多少都行？一塊錢也可以？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Even zero. There's a no tip button.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈivən ˈzɪroʊ ðɛrz ə noʊ tɪp ˈbʌtən./
dialogue.zh: 零也可以，有一個不給小費的按鈕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No tip button? Where is that?
dialogue.zh: 不給小費的按鈕？那個在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bottom right corner, see the small gray box?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɑtəm raɪt ˈkɔrnər si ðə smɔl ɡreɪ bɑks./
dialogue.zh: 右下角，看到那個灰色小框了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I see it. Nobody presses that.
dialogue.zh: 看到了，應該沒人會按這個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Some do, and that's okay too.
dialogue.zh: 也有人按，那也沒關係。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I'll tap the twenty button.
dialogue.zh: 好，那我按百分之二十那個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it. Want the receipt?
dialogue.zh: 收到。要收據嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, email one to my old address.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈimel wʌn tə maɪ oʊld əˈdrɛs./
dialogue.zh: 好，傳一封到我舊的信箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done. Do you also want a paper copy?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn du ju ˈɔlsoʊ wɑnt ə ˈpeɪpər ˈkɑpi./
dialogue.zh: 傳好了。還要紙本收據嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, that's all. What's my number?
dialogue.zh: 不用了。我的取餐號碼是？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twelve, written on your cup tag.
dialogue.zh: 十二，寫在你杯子的貼條上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twelve. How long will that take?
dialogue.zh: 十二。要等多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two minutes, the machine is warm.
dialogue.zh: 兩分鐘，機器已經熱好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great. Can I wait by the counter?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt kæn aɪ weɪt baɪ ðə ˈkaʊntər./
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我可以在櫃台邊等嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, right there is fine for now.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs raɪt ðɛr ɪz faɪn fər naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 可以，先站那裡就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One thing, the screen asked me again.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn θɪŋ ðə skrin æskt mi əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 有個狀況，畫面又問了我一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, that second page is for the crew.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðæt ˈsɛkənd peɪdʒ ɪz fər ðə kru./
dialogue.zh: 喔，第二頁是問團隊的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The crew? But you're the only one here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kru bʌt jʊr ðə ˈoʊnli wʌn hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 團隊？可這裡只有你一個人耶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Baristas split the counter tips every night.
dialogue.phonetic: /bəˈrɪstəz splɪt ðə ˈkaʊntər tɪps ˈɛvri naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 咖啡師每天晚上會平分櫃台小費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So that page takes from my tip?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðæt peɪdʒ teɪks frʌm maɪ tɪp./
dialogue.zh: 所以那一頁是從我的小費裡拿？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the two pages ask separately.
dialogue.zh: 不會，兩個畫面是分開問的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I already pressed the first one.
dialogue.zh: 我剛剛已經按過第一個了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then this one is extra, or skip.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðɪs wʌn ɪz ˈɛkstrə ɔr skɪp./
dialogue.zh: 那這個是另外加的，不然就跳過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll skip this. Don't want double.
dialogue.zh: 這個我跳過，不想給兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair enough. Your coffee's coming now.
dialogue.zh: 很合理。你的咖啡這就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I ask one money thing?
dialogue.zh: 我可以問一個關於錢的事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, go ahead while I steam.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔrs ɡoʊ əˈhɛd waɪl aɪ stim./
dialogue.zh: 當然，我打奶泡你剛好問。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do people tip here every single day?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ˈpipəl tɪp hɪr ˈɛvri ˈsɪŋɡəl deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 這裡的人每天都給小費嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most regulars do, but not each cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst ˈrɛɡjələrz du bʌt nɑt itʃ kʌp./
dialogue.zh: 常客多數會給，但不是每一杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about tomorrow morning, same screen?
dialogue.zh: 那明天早上也是同樣的畫面嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same screen, so same three buttons.
dialogue.zh: 同一個系統，所以還是那三個按鈕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I tip one day and not the next?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ tɪp wʌn deɪ ænd nɑt ðə nɛkst./
dialogue.zh: 我可以今天給、明天不給嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Absolutely. Nothing here is recorded.
dialogue.zh: 當然可以，這裡都不記名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That helps a lot, honestly.
dialogue.zh: 聽你這樣說我安心多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'd rather see a relaxed face.
dialogue.zh: 我們寧可看到客人輕鬆的表情。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you see who chose which amount?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju si hu tʃoz wɪtʃ əˈmaʊnt./
dialogue.zh: 你們會看到誰選了多少嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the total lands at closing time.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ðə ˈtoʊtəl lændz æt ˈkloʊzɪŋ taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 不會，結帳時只看到總數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So you don't know it was me?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ju doʊnt noʊ ɪt wʌz mi./
dialogue.zh: 所以你不知道是我給的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not unless I carry your cup out.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ʌnˈlɛs aɪ ˈkæri jɔr kʌp aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 除非是我把那杯端給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more question about the amount.
dialogue.zh: 再問一個關於金額的事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask away, I like these questions.
dialogue.zh: 你問吧，我喜歡這種問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is a dollar too little here?
dialogue.zh: 給一塊會不會太少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On one coffee? No, that's plenty.
dialogue.zh: 一杯咖啡嗎？不會，那很夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, because I only have small bills.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd bɪˈkɔz aɪ ˈoʊnli hæv smɔl bɪlz./
dialogue.zh: 好，因為我身上只有小鈔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small bills work in the jar too.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl bɪlz wɜrk ɪn ðə dʒɑr tu./
dialogue.zh: 小鈔也可以放進罐子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is that jar, then?
dialogue.zh: 那那個罐子在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The jar beside the register, right there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə dʒɑr bəˈsaɪd ðə ˈrɛdʒɪstər raɪt ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 收銀機旁邊那個玻璃罐，就那裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The jar with your names on it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə dʒɑr wɪð jɔr neɪmz ɑn ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 貼著你們名字的那個罐子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one. Loose change goes to the crew.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌn lus tʃeɪndʒ ɡoʊz tə ðə kru./
dialogue.zh: 對那個。零錢是大家分的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cash tip or card tip, which is better?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæʃ tɪp ɔr kɑrd tɪp wɪtʃ ɪz ˈbɛtər./
dialogue.zh: 現金小費和刷卡小費，哪個比較好？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cash at the counter is my favorite.
dialogue.phonetic: /kæʃ æt ðə ˈkaʊntər ɪz maɪ ˈfeɪvərɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我最愛直接在櫃台給現金。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is cash better if it's equal?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ ɪz kæʃ ˈbɛtər ɪf ɪts ˈikwəl./
dialogue.zh: 金額一樣的話，為什麼現金比較好？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It reaches the right hands today.
dialogue.zh: 因為錢今天就進到對的人口袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twelve! That cup says Ben on it.
dialogue.phonetic: /twɛlv ðæt kʌp sɛz bɛn ɑn ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 十二號！那杯寫著班。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All yours. Want me to check the lid?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl jʊrz wɑnt mi tu tʃɛk ðə lɪd./
dialogue.zh: 是你的。要我幫你檢查杯蓋嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me smell it first. Perfect.
dialogue.zh: 讓我先聞一下，很完美。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Glad it came out right today.
dialogue.zh: 很高興這次煮得剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I have tipped before you poured it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ həv tɪpt bɪˈfɔr ju pɔrd ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我該在你倒咖啡之前就給嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the screen can wait till you leave.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ðə skrin kæn weɪt tɪl ju liv./
dialogue.zh: 不用，畫面可以等你要走時再按。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I'll drop some change in the jar.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪl drɑp səm tʃeɪndʒ ɪn ðə dʒɑr./
dialogue.zh: 那我就把零錢放進罐子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks, I'll add it to tonight's pool.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks aɪl æd ɪt tə təˈnaɪts pul./
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，我晚上會算進大家的分成。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cold weather makes a hot cup better.
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊld ˈwɛðər meɪks ə hɑt kʌp ˈbɛtər./
dialogue.zh: 天氣冷的時候，熱飲特別好喝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right? Cold days are our busiest season.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt koʊld deɪz ɑr ɑʊər ˈbɪzist ˈsizən./
dialogue.zh: 是呀，冷天是我們最忙的季節。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The screen timed out while we talked.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə skrin taɪmd aʊt waɪl wi tɔkt./
dialogue.zh: 我們聊太久，畫面自己關掉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No worries, you already pressed a button.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈwɜriz ju ɔlˈrɛdi prɛst ə ˈbʌtən./
dialogue.zh: 別擔心，你之前已經按過了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It went back to the drink menu, see?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wɛnt bæk tə ðə drɪŋk ˈmɛnju si./
dialogue.zh: 它跳回飲品選單了，你看？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That page is ours, not yours, Ben.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt peɪdʒ ɪz ɑrz nɑt jʊrz bɛn./
dialogue.zh: 那頁是給我們看的，不是你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My coworker says I should always tip.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈkoʊwɜrkər sɛz aɪ ʃʊd ˈɔlweɪz tɪp./
dialogue.zh: 我同事說我應該每次都給。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your coworker is mostly right, yeah.
dialogue.zh: 你同事說得大致是對的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But she gives fifteen percent every time.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt ʃi ɡɪvz fɪfˈtin pərˈsɛnt ˈɛvri taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 但她每次都只給百分之十五。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fifteen is low for a counter, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɪfˈtin ɪz loʊ fər ə ˈkaʊntər ˈɑnəstli./
dialogue.zh: 老實說，櫃台給十五偏低了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So twenty is a normal starting point?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈtwɛnti ɪz ə ˈnɔrməl ˈstɑrtɪŋ pɔɪnt./
dialogue.zh: 那二十是平常的起跑點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty is fine. Twenty-five if it's great.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti ɪz faɪn ˈtwɛnti faɪv ɪf ɪts ɡreɪt./
dialogue.zh: 二十很好，超滿意就給二十五。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. Same order tomorrow at eight?
dialogue.zh: 太好了。明天八點一樣一杯？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same shift tomorrow. Have a good one.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm ʃɪft təˈmɑroʊ hæv ə ɡʊd wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 我明天也上班，祝你今天順利。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hey, it's the coffee guy again.
dialogue.zh: 嗨，又是那個咖啡常客。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Number twelve! Back for another round?
dialogue.zh: 十二號！再來一杯喔？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One black coffee, same as before.
dialogue.zh: 一杯黑咖啡，跟之前一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Easy. Tap whenever you're ready.
dialogue.zh: 簡單。準備好就按。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Before I tap, one honest question.
dialogue.zh: 按之前，我想問個誠實的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, ask me anything today.
dialogue.zh: 好呀，今天你想問什麼都行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I have to tip here?
dialogue.zh: 在這裡我非給小費不可嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, nobody has to tip here.
dialogue.zh: 不，沒有人非給不可。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I know, but should I, though?
dialogue.zh: 我知道，可是我該不該給？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Should? Most people do, that's it.
dialogue.zh: 應該嗎？多數人都會給，就這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who decided that, the company?
dialogue.zh: 是誰決定的，公司嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it's just how it works.
dialogue.zh: 不是，這裡的規矩本來就這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just how it works? That's funny.
dialogue.zh: 本來就這樣？有點好笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is, nobody enjoys the math.
dialogue.zh: 是呀，沒人愛算那數學。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My friend says tipping is rude.
dialogue.zh: 我朋友說給小費很失禮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Some places hate it, that's real too.
dialogue.phonetic: /sʌm ˈpleɪsəz heɪt ɪt ðæts ril tu./
dialogue.zh: 有些地方確實討厭小費，那也是真的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What happens if I press zero?
dialogue.zh: 如果我按零會怎樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nothing at all, I still make it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌθɪŋ ət ɔl aɪ stɪl meɪk ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 什麼事都沒有，我照樣幫你煮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You really wouldn't mind at all?
dialogue.zh: 你真的完全不會在意？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'd mind my own job, honestly.
dialogue.zh: 老實說，我只專心做我的工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would my coffee come slower, though?
dialogue.zh: 那我的咖啡會做比較慢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the timer doesn't know names.
dialogue.zh: 不會，計時器不認得名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's a good answer, thanks.
dialogue.zh: 這答案真好，謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I've heard that one ten times.
dialogue.zh: 那問題我聽過十遍了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten times today? From many people?
dialogue.zh: 今天十遍？好多人都問？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Different faces, same three words.
dialogue.zh: 臉都不同，但那三個字一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three words? Tell me which ones.
dialogue.zh: 三個字？告訴我哪三個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is it needed? That's the usual.
dialogue.zh: 「必須給嗎？」大家都是這句。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it needed. Yes, that's my line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt ˈnidɪd jɛs ðæts maɪ laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 「必須給嗎」，對，我就是這句。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost your exact words, by the way.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlmoʊst jɔr ɪɡˈzækt wɜrdz baɪ ðə weɪ./
dialogue.zh: 你說得跟他們幾乎一模一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here's something I don't get yet.
dialogue.zh: 還有件事我一直不懂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go on, the line is short.
dialogue.zh: 你說吧，現在隊伍不長。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the owner keep the tips?
dialogue.zh: 老闆會拿走小費嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, that's actually against the law.
dialogue.zh: 不會，那其實是違法行為。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Against the law? Really, here?
dialogue.zh: 違法？真的假的，在這裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, tips belong to the staff.
dialogue.zh: 真的，小費本來就屬於員工。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So you keep all of mine?
dialogue.zh: 那我給的都是你的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I keep a part, the rest is shared.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kip ə pɑrt ðə rɛst ɪz ʃɛrd./
dialogue.zh: 我拿一部分，其餘大家分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shared with who, exactly?
dialogue.zh: 確切來說是跟誰分？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The dishwasher and the closing crew.
dialogue.zh: 洗碗的，還有收店的幾位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The dishwasher gets part of my tip?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈdɪʃˌwɑʃər ɡɛts pɑrt ʌv maɪ tɪp./
dialogue.zh: 洗碗的也能分到我的小費？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, he's on the tip list.
dialogue.zh: 對，他在分小費的名單上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I never thought about him.
dialogue.zh: 我從沒想過他的份。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most people don't, that's okay.
dialogue.zh: 多數人也不會想，這沒關係。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing about my phone.
dialogue.zh: 還有一件跟我手機有關的事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The app order? What's the question?
dialogue.zh: 手機下單那個嗎？你想問什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I paid in the app yesterday.
dialogue.zh: 我昨天在手機裡就付完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, the tip page came after that.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ðə tɪp peɪdʒ keɪm ˈæftər ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 對，那之後會跳小費頁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A tip page? Where, when exactly?
dialogue.zh: 小費頁？在哪裡，什麼時候出現？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At the end, or in your history.
dialogue.phonetic: /æt ði ɛnd ɔr ɪn jɔr ˈhɪstəri./
dialogue.zh: 訂單最後面，或是紀錄裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I never looked at the history.
dialogue.zh: 我從來沒去看訂單紀錄。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It stays open for a few days.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt steɪz ˈoʊpən fər ə fju deɪz./
dialogue.zh: 那個會留好幾天讓你改。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So I can still fix that one?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ aɪ kæn stɪl fɪks ðæt wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 所以我還能補昨天那筆？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, tap the order and edit.
dialogue.zh: 可以，點那筆訂單再編輯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Show me quick, my thumbs are slow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃoʊ mi kwɪk maɪ θʌmz ɑr sloʊ./
dialogue.zh: 快速教我一下，我手指很慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, hold the phone, tap once.
dialogue.zh: 來，拿著手機，點一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There it is! The empty line.
dialogue.zh: 找到了！那個空白欄位。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now type your number, then save.
dialogue.zh: 現在輸入數字，再存檔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saved. That felt weirdly good.
dialogue.zh: 存好了，感覺有點莫名的爽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It happens to everyone on day one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈhæpənz tə ˈɛvriwʌn ɑn deɪ wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 每個人第一次都這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My drink came wrong last week.
dialogue.zh: 上週我的飲料做錯了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The oat milk one? I remember.
dialogue.zh: 燕麥奶那杯嗎？我記得。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I tip when it's wrong?
dialogue.zh: 做錯的時候我還是要給嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's your call, no rule there.
dialogue.zh: 那由你決定，那裡沒規則。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I fixed it myself, though.
dialogue.zh: 況且我自己去換掉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You did, and you were polite.
dialogue.zh: 你有，而且你很有禮貌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Refills are free here, right?
dialogue.zh: 這裡續杯是免費的，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same day, same cup, free.
dialogue.zh: 同一天、同一杯，免費續。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does a free refill need money?
dialogue.zh: 那免費續杯要給錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, but a coin never hurts.
dialogue.zh: 不用，但丟個銅板永遠不吃虧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I also bought a muffin.
dialogue.zh: 我還買了一個瑪芬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Was that on the same receipt?
dialogue.zh: 那開在同一張收據上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, the muffin was its own check.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ðə ˈmʌfən wʌz ɪts oʊn tʃɛk./
dialogue.zh: 沒有，瑪芬是單獨結帳。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the machine saw only the coffee.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə məˈʃin sɔ ˈoʊnli ðə ˈkɔfi./
dialogue.zh: 那機器只看到咖啡那筆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Meaning my tip was too small?
dialogue.zh: 意思是我給少了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little, since it saw only the cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪtəl sɪns ɪt sɔ ˈoʊnli ðə kʌp./
dialogue.zh: 有一點，因為它只算那杯咖啡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do people split a tip?
dialogue.zh: 兩個人分開付時小費怎麼算？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two cards, one tip line each.
dialogue.zh: 兩張卡，各自簽自己的那欄。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My coworker paid for both cups.
dialogue.zh: 我同事幫我們兩杯都付了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then she chooses, or you hand her cash.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ʃi ˈtʃuzəz ɔr ju hænd hɜr kæʃ./
dialogue.zh: 那就讓她決定，不然你給她現金。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I gave her two dollars for the tip.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ɡeɪv hɜr tu ˈdɑlərz fər ðə tɪp./
dialogue.zh: 我給她兩塊錢當小費。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's clean, no screen needed.
dialogue.zh: 這樣最乾淨，不用看畫面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There's a new girl today?
dialogue.zh: 今天來了新來的同事？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Monday trainee, she's still learning.
dialogue.zh: 週一剛來的見習，還在學。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I tip more for that?
dialogue.zh: 那我該多給一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She gets the pool, not the button.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi ɡɛts ðə pul nɑt ðə ˈbʌtən./
dialogue.zh: 她領的是公池那份，不是按鈕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The pool again. Okay, got it.
dialogue.zh: 又是公池，好，我懂了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So your tip still helps her out.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ jɔr tɪp stɪl hɛlps hɜr aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 所以你的小費還是有幫到她。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lunch rush is coming, isn't it?
dialogue.zh: 午餐人潮要來了，是吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In ten minutes, here we go.
dialogue.zh: 再十分鐘就要開始忙了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do people tip more when it's busy?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ˈpipəl tɪp mɔr wɛn ɪts ˈbɪzi./
dialogue.zh: 忙碌的時候人們會多給嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The busy days show the best tips.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈbɪzi deɪz ʃoʊ ðə bɛst tɪps./
dialogue.zh: 最忙的那幾天小費反而最好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten cups for my office today.
dialogue.zh: 今天幫公司帶十杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Big order! The screen notices that.
dialogue.zh: 大單喔！畫面會感覺到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It notices? It's just buttons.
dialogue.zh: 它會感覺？不就幾個按鈕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It suggests more on a big total.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt səkˈdʒɛsts mɔr ɑn ə bɪɡ ˈtoʊtəl./
dialogue.zh: 金額大的時候它會建議多一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll take the thirty percent, then.
dialogue.zh: 那我就按百分之三十。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That'll make my whole morning.
dialogue.zh: 那我整個早上都有動力了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Jar or screen for this one?
dialogue.zh: 這單要放罐子還是按畫面？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Screen for the big one, jar for small.
dialogue.phonetic: /skrin fər ðə bɪɡ wʌn dʒɑr fər smɔl./
dialogue.zh: 大單用畫面，小錢進罐子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hello! Two croissants, one plain, one sweet.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɛˈloʊ tu krwaˈsɑntz wʌn pleɪn wʌn swit./
dialogue.zh: 你好！兩個可頌，一個原味、一個甜的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Warm ones? They just came out.
dialogue.zh: 要熱的嗎？他們剛出爐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Warm is perfect. Bag them both.
dialogue.zh: 熱的剛好，兩個都裝袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure. Anything warm to drink?
dialogue.zh: 好。要配什麼熱飲嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No drink, just bread. How much?
dialogue.zh: 不喝東西，只要麵包。多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's six fifty, tax is in.
dialogue.zh: 六塊五，稅已經在裡面了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six fifty. Do you take cards?
dialogue.zh: 六塊五。這裡收卡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We do, but the sign says cash first.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi du bʌt ðə saɪn sɛz kæʃ fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 收，但牌子上寫現金優先。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cash first? Is the machine broken again?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæʃ fɜrst ɪz ðə məˈʃin ˈbroʊkən əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 現金優先？機器又壞了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, we just like fewer fees.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，我們只是想少付手續費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fewer fees on cards, you mean?
dialogue.zh: 你是說刷卡的費用比較多？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the card keeps a small part.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə kɑrd kips ə smɔl pɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 對，卡片那一邊會抽一小塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A part of my money? Even tips?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə pɑrt ʌv maɪ ˈmʌni ˈivən tɪps./
dialogue.zh: 抽我的一小部分？連小費也抽？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Even the tips, that's the honest part.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈivən ðə tɪps ðæts ði ˈɑnəst pɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 連小費也抽，這是老實說法。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's honest. I like that answer.
dialogue.zh: 這樣蠻誠實的，我喜歡這答案。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Weird, but true, every single week.
dialogue.zh: 聽起來怪，但每週都是這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I only have a ten on me.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈoʊnli hæv ə tɛn ɑn mi./
dialogue.zh: 我身上只有十塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten it is. Your change is three fifty.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ɪt ɪz jɔr tʃeɪndʒ ɪz θri ˈfɪfti./
dialogue.zh: 十塊沒問題，找你三塊五。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three fifty. I'll keep it for the jar.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri ˈfɪfti aɪl kip ɪt fər ðə dʒɑr./
dialogue.zh: 三塊五啊，那我留著放進罐子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The crew will like that, honestly.
dialogue.zh: 內場的人會很開心的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I put it, the jar?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du aɪ pʊt ɪt ðə dʒɑr./
dialogue.zh: 那要放哪裡，放罐子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The glass one by the register.
dialogue.zh: 收銀機旁邊那個玻璃罐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The one with the cookies on the lid?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wʌn wɪð ðə ˈkʊkiz ɑn ðə lɪd./
dialogue.zh: 蓋子上貼餅乾圖的那個嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's ours, yes, see the tape label?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ɑrz jɛs si ðə teɪp ˈleɪbəl./
dialogue.zh: 對那個，看到膠帶貼的標籤嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It says, for the morning crew.
dialogue.zh: 寫著「早上那組專用」。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bakers, the counter, and the table kid.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbeɪkərz ðə ˈkaʊntər ænd ðə ˈteɪbəl kɪd./
dialogue.zh: 麵包師傅、櫃台，還有收桌的孩子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There's a kid who clears tables?
dialogue.zh: 有個小孩專門收桌子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two tables, one kid, it works out.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈteɪbəlz wʌn kɪd ɪt wɜrks aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 兩張桌子一個孩子，剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A kid clears tables for tips?
dialogue.zh: 小孩收桌子是為了小費？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He's nineteen, and he saves fast.
dialogue.zh: 他十九歲，存錢存得很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's a good story for a jar.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ə ɡʊd ˈstɔri fər ə dʒɑr./
dialogue.zh: 這故事配那個罐子剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A wage story would be better.
dialogue.zh: 若有底薪，那故事就更好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There are already bills inside it.
dialogue.zh: 裡面已經有鈔票了耶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fridays are full, Mondays are thin.
dialogue.zh: 星期五滿滿的，星期一就空空。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So you don't count it daily?
dialogue.zh: 所以你們不是每天點錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We count it Sunday, all together.
dialogue.zh: 我們週日一起點一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: All together, then split by hours?
dialogue.zh: 全部加起來，再依工時分？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: By hours, yes, that's the rule.
dialogue.zh: 按工時，對，規矩是這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I like that rule, it's clear.
dialogue.zh: 我喜歡這規矩，很清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clear rules make calm mornings here.
dialogue.zh: 規則清楚，早上就不會吵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I also get a rye bread?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ˈɔlsoʊ ɡɛt ə raɪ brɛd./
dialogue.zh: 我還可以再買一條黑麥麵包嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The rye is on the last shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə raɪ ɪz ɑn ðə læst ʃɛlf./
dialogue.zh: 黑麥的在最裡面那層架。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Too high, can you reach it?
dialogue.zh: 太高了，你拿得到嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, one rye, coming right down.
dialogue.zh: 可以，一條黑麥麵包，馬上拿下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks. That's two fifty more.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，那是兩塊五。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two fifty, and the card is fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈfɪfti ænd ðə kɑrd ɪz faɪn./
dialogue.zh: 兩塊五，刷卡也可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, I'm out of cash anyway.
dialogue.zh: 好，反正我現金都給出去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tap it, then. We lose a small fee.
dialogue.phonetic: /tæp ɪt ðɛn wi luz ə smɔl fi./
dialogue.zh: 那就刷吧，我們會扣一點手續費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's fine, I have no coins left.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts faɪn aɪ hæv noʊ kɔɪnz lɛft./
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，我銅板也花完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There's a coin cup by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛrz ə kɔɪn kʌp baɪ ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 門口有一個零錢杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A cup I can take from?
dialogue.zh: 一個可以拿錢的杯子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take only change, never the paper.
dialogue.zh: 只能拿銅板，不碰鈔票。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only change, never paper. Got it.
dialogue.zh: 只拿銅板不拿鈔票，懂了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most folks respect that little cup.
dialogue.zh: 多數人都會尊重那個小杯子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lady before me gave two bills.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈleɪdi bɪˈfɔr mi ɡeɪv tu bɪlz./
dialogue.zh: 我前面那位姊姊放了兩張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She does that every Saturday, always.
dialogue.zh: 她每週六都這樣，每次都給。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Every Saturday? She's not rich.
dialogue.zh: 每週六？她看起來也不有錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She's a regular, that's the reason.
dialogue.zh: 因為她是常客，這就是理由。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So regulars tip without being asked?
dialogue.zh: 所以常客不用人問就會給？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They tip before we even look.
dialogue.zh: 我們還沒看，他們就放好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's a nicer way to learn.
dialogue.zh: 這比看螢幕學到更多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The screen teaches numbers, not faces.
dialogue.zh: 螢幕只教數字，不教人臉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My screen tip felt like nothing.
dialogue.zh: 我在螢幕上按小費，沒什麼感覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A jar is a person, not a button.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə dʒɑr ɪz ə ˈpɜrsən nɑt ə ˈbʌtən./
dialogue.zh: 罐子是給人的，不是給按鈕的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's a good line. May I use it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ə ɡʊd laɪn meɪ aɪ juz ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 這句話說得好，我可以借用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use it anywhere, it's free advice.
dialogue.zh: 哪都能用，這建議免費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing, the birthday box.
dialogue.zh: 還有一件事，那個生日盒子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The cookies with the ribbon on top?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkʊkiz wɪð ðə ˈrɪbən ɑn tɑp./
dialogue.zh: 上面綁緞帶的那盒餅乾嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, twelve cookies for a party.
dialogue.zh: 對，派對要十二塊餅乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Boxed, bagged, and no candles, right?
dialogue.zh: 裝盒、套袋，不附蠟燭，對了喔？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No candles. Can I leave cash inside?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈkændəlz kæn aɪ liv kæʃ ɪnˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 不附蠟燭。我能在裡面留現金嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can leave it inside the bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn liv ɪt ɪnˈsaɪd ðə bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 你可以直接把錢留在袋子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: In the bag? Under the cookies?
dialogue.zh: 在袋子裡？放在餅乾下面？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In an envelope, we have those.
dialogue.zh: 放進信封，我們有信封。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: An envelope with my name on it?
dialogue.phonetic: /æn ˈɑnvəˌloʊ wɪð maɪ neɪm ɑn ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 信封上寫我的名字嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We write the crew's name, not yours.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi raɪt ðə kruz neɪm nɑt jʊrz./
dialogue.zh: 我們寫內場的名，不寫你的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So they never know who gave it?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðeɪ ˈnɛvər noʊ hu ɡeɪv ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 所以他們永遠不知道是誰給的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They know the order, not the face.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ noʊ ði ˈɔrdər nɑt ðə feɪs./
dialogue.zh: 他們知道是哪一單，不知道臉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair. Two envelopes, please, then.
dialogue.zh: 公道。那請給我兩個信封。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One for the counter, one for the back.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn fər ðə ˈkaʊntər wʌn fər ðə bæk./
dialogue.zh: 一個給櫃台，一個給內場。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The back is where the ovens are?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bæk ɪz wɛr ði ˈʌvənz ɑr./
dialogue.zh: 內場就是烤箱那裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ovens, mixers, and very tired feet.
dialogue.zh: 烤箱、攪拌機，還有很累的腳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then the second envelope goes there.
dialogue.zh: 那第二個信封就放那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That'll make someone's whole afternoon.
dialogue.zh: 那會讓某個人的下午整個亮起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I pay now, or after pickup?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ peɪ naʊ ɔr ˈæftər ˈpɪkˌʌp./
dialogue.zh: 我現在付，還是取貨時付？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: After is fine, come back at four.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæftər ɪz faɪn kʌm bæk æt fɔr./
dialogue.zh: 之後付也可以，四點再來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four o'clock, the box will be ready.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr əˈklɑk ðə bɑks wɪl bi ˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 四點，盒子就會好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ready, boxed, and on that shelf.
dialogue.zh: 好了、裝好了，放那層架上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll bring cash for the jar, too.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl brɪŋ kæʃ fər ðə dʒɑr tu./
dialogue.zh: 我也會帶現金放進罐子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are a jar person now.
dialogue.zh: 你現在是罐子派的人了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You sell coffee here as well?
dialogue.zh: 你們這裡也賣咖啡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two machines, one line, morning only.
dialogue.zh: 兩台機器、一條隊伍，只賣早上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I tip the coffee guy here?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ tɪp ðə ˈkɔfi ɡaɪ hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 那這裡煮咖啡的人也要給嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same jar, so the answer is yes.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm dʒɑr soʊ ði ˈænsər ɪz jɛs./
dialogue.zh: 同一個罐子，所以答案是給。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One jar for everything in this shop?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn dʒɑr fər ˈɛvriθɪŋ ɪn ðɪs ʃɑp./
dialogue.zh: 整間店共用一個罐子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One jar, three names, fair math.
dialogue.zh: 一個罐子、三個名字，算得公平。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, see you at four then.
dialogue.zh: 好，那四點見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See you then, bring a bigger bill.
dialogue.phonetic: /si ju ðɛn brɪŋ ə ˈbɪɡər bɪl./
dialogue.zh: 四點見，帶張大一點的鈔票。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you open on Sunday morning?
dialogue.zh: 你們週日早上會開嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sundays till two, sold out by ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌndeɪz tɪl tu soʊld aʊt baɪ tɛn./
dialogue.zh: 週日開到兩點，十點就賣光。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, hi. It's pouring out there.
dialogue.zh: 喔，你好。外面下超大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Evening! Two bags, one soup, all yours.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈivnɪŋ tu bæɡz wʌn sup ɔl jʊrz./
dialogue.zh: 晚上好！兩袋、一碗湯，都是你的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two bags? I only ordered one.
dialogue.zh: 兩袋？我只點了一袋耶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Drinks in one, food in the other.
dialogue.phonetic: /drɪŋks ɪn wʌn fud ɪn ði ˈʌðər./
dialogue.zh: 飲料裝一袋，吃的裝另一袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Come in a second, out of the rain.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌm ɪn ə ˈsɛkənd aʊt ʌv ðə reɪn./
dialogue.zh: 進來一下嘛，躲一下雨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can't, I have three drops left.
dialogue.zh: 不行，我還有三家要送。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three more? In this weather?
dialogue.zh: 還三家？這種天氣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The rain stops in ten, maybe.
dialogue.zh: 雨十分鐘就會停，大概吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your sleeves are completely wet.
dialogue.zh: 你整條袖子都濕透了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleeves only, the bag stayed dry.
dialogue.zh: 只有袖子，袋子一直保持乾的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's the important part, then.
dialogue.zh: 那重點就對了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, the food is my customer.
dialogue.zh: 對呀，餐點才是我的客人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I still pay you at the door?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ stɪl peɪ ju æt ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 我還要當面付你錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nothing, the app took it already.
dialogue.zh: 不用了，軟體已經扣過了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Already? Then the tip is inside?
dialogue.zh: 已經付了？那小費也在裡面嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's after the drop, on your phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈæftər ðə drɑp ɑn jɔr foʊn./
dialogue.zh: 是送完之後，在你手機上按。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: After you leave. So you don't see it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæftər ju liv soʊ ju doʊnt si ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 你走之後才有？那你看不到？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I see it tomorrow, in the summary.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ si ɪt təˈmɑroʊ ɪn ðə ˈsəməri./
dialogue.zh: 我明天在總表裡才看得到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's strange. I want to thank you now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts streɪndʒ aɪ wɑnt tə θæŋk ju naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 這樣有點怪，我現在就想謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then rate five and write one line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn reɪt faɪv ænd raɪt wʌn laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 那你就給五星，寫一行字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can do that, sure. One problem.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn du ðæt ʃʊr wʌn ˈprɑbləm./
dialogue.zh: 這我可以。不過有個問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A problem? Tell me what's missing.
dialogue.zh: 有問題？缺什麼跟我說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The napkins are missing again.
dialogue.zh: 餐巾紙又沒給了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Again? That's the third time this month.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈɡɛn ðæts ðə θɜrd taɪm ðɪs mʌnθ./
dialogue.zh: 又漏？這個月第三次了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Third time, and I still have no forks.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɜrd taɪm ænd aɪ stɪl hæv noʊ fɔrks./
dialogue.zh: 第三次了，而且我連叉子都沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll grab some from my bag, wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl ɡræb sʌm frʌm maɪ bæɡ weɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我從袋子裡拿一些給你，等一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You keep napkins in the car?
dialogue.zh: 你車上會備餐巾紙？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two packs, drivers keep a stash.
dialogue.zh: 兩包，我們司機都會存一疊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That saves my dinner, honestly.
dialogue.zh: 那真的救了我這頓晚餐。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, take both packs, no charge.
dialogue.zh: 給，兩包都拿去，不用錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No charge? Then let me hand you cash.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ tʃɑrdʒ ðɛn lɛt mi hænd ju kæʃ./
dialogue.zh: 不用錢？那我直接給你現金。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can, if you have bills at home.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn ɪf ju hæv bɪlz æt hoʊm./
dialogue.zh: 可以啊，只要你家裡面有鈔票。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bills. I have zero at home tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪlz aɪ hæv ˈzɪroʊ æt hoʊm təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 鈔票啊，我今晚一塊都沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then do it in the app, it's fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn du ɪt ɪn ði æp ɪts faɪn./
dialogue.zh: 那就在軟體裡按，沒關係。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tapping after you leave feels cold.
dialogue.zh: 你走之後再按，感覺很冷淡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's not cold, it's how we get paid.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts nɑt koʊld ɪts haʊ wi ɡɛt peɪd./
dialogue.zh: 不冷淡啦，我們就是這樣領錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, the soup lid came off.
dialogue.zh: 等等，湯的蓋子脫落了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no. The bag is wet inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ ðə bæɡ ɪz wɛt ɪnˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 噢不，袋子裡面都濕了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that your fault, or the road?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt jɔr fɔlt ɔr ðə roʊd./
dialogue.zh: 這是你的問題，還是路的問題？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine. I braked hard at the corner.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn aɪ breɪkd hɑrd æt ðə ˈkɔrnər./
dialogue.zh: 我的，轉彎時我踩了急煞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I still rate you, then?
dialogue.zh: 那我還要給你好評分嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your call. I'd ask for a refund.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr kɔl aɪd æsk fər ə ˈriˌfənd./
dialogue.zh: 你決定。我會去申請退款。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I ask for that back?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ æsk fər ðæt bæk./
dialogue.zh: 那個錢我要怎麼要回來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tap help, then the missing item.
dialogue.zh: 點協助，再選缺少的那項。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Found it. Do they refund the soup?
dialogue.phonetic: /faʊnd ɪt du ðeɪ ˈriˌfənd ðə sup./
dialogue.zh: 找到了。湯會退錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Usually, and you keep the bread.
dialogue.zh: 通常會退，而且麵包你留著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, that's not so bad, then.
dialogue.zh: 好吧，那情況沒那麼糟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's a bad night, not a bad order.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ə bæd naɪt nɑt ə bæd ˈɔrdər./
dialogue.zh: 是今晚天氣壞，不是這一單壞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're very calm about all this.
dialogue.zh: 你對這一切真的很冷靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My first month, I cried twice.
dialogue.zh: 我剛做的第一個月哭過兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cried? Over a spilled soup?
dialogue.zh: 哭？就因為打翻一碗湯？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Over one star, to be honest.
dialogue.zh: 是因為一顆星，說實話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's rough. I'm sorry about that.
dialogue.zh: 那樣很難受，我很抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's fine now, I have thick skin.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts faɪn naʊ aɪ hæv θɪk skɪn./
dialogue.zh: 現在好了，我臉皮變厚了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thick skin and two wet sleeves.
dialogue.zh: 臉皮厚，外加兩隻濕袖子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both free of charge tonight, apparently.
dialogue.zh: 今晚兩者都免費提供，看來是。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me get you a towel, one second.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi ɡɛt ju ə ˈtaʊəl wʌn ˈsɛkənd./
dialogue.zh: 我去拿一條毛巾給你，一下下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're kind, but I'll stay on the mat.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr kaɪnd bʌt aɪl steɪ ɑn ðə mæt./
dialogue.zh: 你真好，但我站在門墊上就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No dripping inside my hallway.
dialogue.zh: 不行，不能滴在我的走廊裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, fair. The mat works, thanks.
dialogue.zh: 哈，有道理。地墊就夠了，謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sixth floor, no elevator, right?
dialogue.zh: 六樓、沒有電梯，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You wrote it down, I walked it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju roʊt ɪt daʊn aɪ wɔkt ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 你有寫在備註裡，我走上來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You carried two bags up six flights.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ˈkærid tu bæɡz ʌp sɪks flaɪts./
dialogue.zh: 你提著兩袋爬了六層樓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the soup on top, careful work.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə sup ɑn tɑp ˈkɛrfəl wɜrk./
dialogue.zh: 湯還在最上面，那可是細活。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That deserves money, not stars.
dialogue.zh: 這個值得的是錢，不是星星。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The stairs pay nothing, the tip does.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə stɛrz peɪ ˈnʌθɪŋ ðə tɪp dʌz./
dialogue.zh: 爬樓梯沒錢拿，小費才有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the app doesn't pay for stairs?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ði æp ˈdʌzənt peɪ fər stɛrz./
dialogue.zh: 所以軟體不會另外給樓梯費？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, stairs are a tip-only bonus.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ stɛrz ɑr ə tɪp ˈoʊnli ˈboʊnəs./
dialogue.zh: 不會，樓梯費只能靠小費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then tell me a fair number.
dialogue.zh: 那你告訴我一個公道的數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Whatever you can. Five is great.
dialogue.zh: 看你能力。五塊就很棒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five for six floors? That's cheap.
dialogue.zh: 六層樓給五塊？這太小氣了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's what most people tap, sadly.
dialogue.zh: 多數人都只按這個，唉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not tonight. I'll do ten in the app.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt təˈnaɪt aɪl du tɛn ɪn ði æp./
dialogue.zh: 今晚不會，我要按十塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten? Are you sure? That's a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ɑr ju ʃʊr ðæts ə lɑt./
dialogue.zh: 十塊？你確定嗎？很多耶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm sure. Wait, my phone just died.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm ʃʊr weɪt maɪ foʊn dʒʌst daɪd./
dialogue.zh: 我確定。等等，我手機剛沒電了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course it did. Tonight's a test.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔrs ɪt dɪd təˈnaɪts ə tɛst./
dialogue.zh: 果然如此，今晚就是在考試。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Give me a second, I need a charger.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɪv mi ə ˈsɛkənd aɪ nid ə ˈtʃɑrdʒər./
dialogue.zh: 給我一下，我要找充電線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take two, I'm parked at the light.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk tu aɪm pɑrkt æt ðə laɪt./
dialogue.zh: 給你兩分鐘，我停在紅綠燈那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you wait? Don't go yet, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju weɪt doʊnt ɡoʊ jɛt pliz./
dialogue.zh: 你可以等一下嗎？先別走。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll knock again in two minutes.
dialogue.zh: 兩分鐘後我再敲一次門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay. I'm charging. Come back now.
dialogue.zh: 好，我在充電了，你回來吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Already? You work fast, neighbor.
dialogue.zh: 這麼快？你動作真快啊，鄰居。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold on. That's my umbrella in your hand!
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ɑn ðæts maɪ ʌmˈbrɛlə ɪn jɔr hænd./
dialogue.zh: 等一下，你手上那是我的傘！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You left it last week, in my car.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju lɛft ɪt læst wik ɪn maɪ kɑr./
dialogue.zh: 你上週落在我車上的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You kept it? A whole week?
dialogue.zh: 你收著？收了整個星期？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It was raining, so I drove it over.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wʌz ˈreɪnɪŋ soʊ aɪ droʊv ɪt ˈoʊvər./
dialogue.zh: 因為在下雨，我就順路載過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You brought my umbrella tonight?
dialogue.zh: 你今晚特地把我的傘送來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You order at eight, I pass here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ˈɔrdər æt eɪt aɪ pæs hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 你八點常點餐，我就會經過這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's the craziest kind thing.
dialogue.zh: 這未免是太貼心的事了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's an umbrella, no big deal.
dialogue.zh: 就一把傘，沒什麼大不了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take the twenty from my drawer.
dialogue.zh: 我抽屜裡有二十塊，你拿去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No cash. Keep your twenty, friend.
dialogue.zh: 不收現金，你那二十塊留著吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then let me tip on the screen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn lɛt mi tɪp ɑn ðə skrin./
dialogue.zh: 那讓我直接在畫面上給小費。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one I'll take, thank you.
dialogue.zh: 這個我就收下，謝謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's loading. What's your name again?
dialogue.zh: 在載入了。你的名字剛剛說什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nina. And write the stairs part.
dialogue.zh: 妮娜。記得寫爬樓梯那段。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stairs, soup, and one umbrella.
dialogue.zh: 樓梯、湯，還有一把傘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's a three line review, yeah.
dialogue.zh: 那就變成三行的評價了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sent. Drive safe, the road is wet.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛnt draɪv seɪf ðə roʊd ɪz wɛt./
dialogue.zh: 傳了。路上慢點，地面很濕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks. Your soup is still warm.
dialogue.zh: 謝啦。你的湯還熱著呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Blue sedan, plate two nine zero?
dialogue.zh: 藍色轎車，車牌二九零？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's mine. You're the rider, Ben?
dialogue.zh: 是我的車。你是叫車的班嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry about the wet floor, my bad.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑri əˈbaʊt ðə wɛt flɔr maɪ bæd./
dialogue.zh: 地板都濕了，真不好意思。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No worries, the mat's in the back.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈwɜriz ðə mæts ɪn ðə bæk./
dialogue.zh: 沒事，墊子就在後座那裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can my bag go in the trunk?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn maɪ bæɡ ɡoʊ ɪn ðə trʌŋk./
dialogue.zh: 我的行李可以放後車箱嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, I'll pop the lid for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr aɪl pɑp ðə lɪd fər ju./
dialogue.zh: 好啊，我幫你開後車箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done. It closed by itself.
dialogue.zh: 好了，它自己關起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the old car does that.
dialogue.zh: 對，老車就會這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Old car, but it smells clean.
dialogue.zh: 車是老，但聞起來很乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, I wipe it each night.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju aɪ waɪp ɪt itʃ naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，我每晚都會擦一遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you do this all day long?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju du ðɪs ɔl deɪ lɔŋ./
dialogue.zh: 你整天都在開這個嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six hours today, then I go home.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ˈaʊərz təˈdeɪ ðɛn aɪ ɡoʊ hoʊm./
dialogue.zh: 今天跑六小時，然後回家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six hours only? Is that enough?
dialogue.zh: 只有六小時？那樣夠嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Enough for one kid, so yes.
dialogue.zh: 養一個小孩夠了，所以夠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry, that was a personal question.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，剛剛那問題比較私人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's fine, half of them ask that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts faɪn hæf ʌv ðɛm æsk ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，一半的乘客都會問。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The map says forty minutes today.
dialogue.zh: 地圖今天顯示四十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Traffic on the bridge, so it does.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtræfɪk ɑn ðə brɪdʒ soʊ ɪt dʌz./
dialogue.zh: 橋上塞車，所以它就是這樣寫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a faster way, maybe?
dialogue.zh: 有沒有比較快的路線？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I know one, but the toll costs.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ noʊ wʌn bʌt ðə toʊl kɔsts./
dialogue.zh: 我知道一條，但那要收過路費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The toll is on me, right?
dialogue.zh: 過路費算我的，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the app adds it later.
dialogue.zh: 對，軟體之後會加進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Later? So the fare will change?
dialogue.zh: 之後？那車資會變？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only the total, never the tip.
dialogue.zh: 只會變總額，不會動到你的小費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, I planned a number already.
dialogue.zh: 好，我心裡先想好數字了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You planned a number? That's cute.
dialogue.zh: 你還會先想數字？好可愛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty percent, in my head.
dialogue.zh: 我在腦中算了百分之二十。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty percent of twenty is four.
dialogue.zh: 二十塊的百分之二十就是四塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's a long ride this morning.
dialogue.zh: 今天早上這趟路很長。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Long ones are the best tips.
dialogue.zh: 長途單的小費通常最好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then why do riders tap so little?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn waɪ du ˈraɪdərz tæp soʊ ˈlɪtəl./
dialogue.zh: 那為什麼乘客都給得很少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Because short trips cost them nothing.
dialogue.zh: 因為路程短，他們覺得不心疼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One thing before we stop here.
dialogue.zh: 下車前我有一件事要問。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask now, the light is red.
dialogue.zh: 現在問吧，我剛好紅燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the tip come straight to you?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə tɪp kʌm streɪt tə ju./
dialogue.zh: 小費是直接到你手上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: To me, in full, that's the rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /tə mi ɪn fʊl ðæts ðə rul./
dialogue.zh: 全額到我這，規矩是這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nobody takes a cut of it?
dialogue.zh: 沒有人抽成嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The company takes none from tips.
dialogue.zh: 公司不會從中抽任何一份。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, then I have no excuse.
dialogue.zh: 好，那我就不推辭了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You never needed one, honestly.
dialogue.zh: 你本來就不需要什麼藉口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We're at the station, right?
dialogue.zh: 我們到車站了，是吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost. Keep your hand off the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlˌmoʊst kip jɔr hænd ɔf ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 快到了，手先別碰車門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Off the door? Why, what's wrong?
dialogue.zh: 別碰車門？怎麼了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nothing wrong, the screen comes first.
dialogue.zh: 沒事，只是要先看那個畫面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The screen. It wants a percent.
dialogue.zh: 這個畫面，它在問百分比。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It gives three, then a custom line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɡɪvz θri ðɛn ə ˈkəstəm laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 它先給三個選項，再給你自訂欄。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Custom, that's what I want today.
dialogue.zh: 自訂，我今天就要用那個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Type it, then press send, not cancel.
dialogue.phonetic: /taɪp ɪt ðɛn prɛs sɛnd nɑt ˈkænsəl./
dialogue.zh: 輸入數字，再按送出，不要按取消。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm slow, my hands are cold.
dialogue.zh: 我動作慢，我的手很冰。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take your time, I'll wait right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk jɔr taɪm aɪl weɪt raɪt hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 你慢慢來，我就停在這裡等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sent! Did your phone just ping?
dialogue.zh: 送出啦！你手機剛剛響了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, it shows by lunchtime.
dialogue.zh: 還沒，要到午餐時間才顯示。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So I can't see your reaction?
dialogue.zh: 所以我看不到你的反應？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look in the mirror, I'm smiling.
dialogue.zh: 看後照鏡，我已經在笑了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There you are. That's worth it.
dialogue.zh: 找到了，那這錢花得值得。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Trunk's open, take your own bag.
dialogue.zh: 後車箱開了，行李自己拿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You let riders take their bags?
dialogue.zh: 你都讓乘客自己拿行李？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please, I drive, I don't carry.
dialogue.zh: 拜託，我是開車的，不負責搬行李。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hey, I did tip, remember?
dialogue.zh: 嘿，我有給耶，記得嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just teasing. Have a good one.
dialogue.zh: 開玩笑的啦，祝你今天順利。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, it's raining harder out there.
dialogue.zh: 等等，外面的雨下得更大了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes. There's an umbrella in the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðɛrz ən ʌmˈbrɛlə ɪn ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 對，車門袋裡有一把傘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: In the door pocket? For me?
dialogue.zh: 在門置物的地方？給我的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For any rider. Take the blue one.
dialogue.phonetic: /fər ˈɛni ˈraɪdər teɪk ðə blu wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 任何乘客都可以，拿藍色那把。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I pay for this umbrella?
dialogue.zh: 這把傘我要付錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nope. Just drop it on the desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊp dʒʌst drɑp ɪt ɑn ðə dɛsk./
dialogue.zh: 不用，放回櫃台就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The desk inside the station?
dialogue.zh: 車站裡面那個櫃台嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The lost and found, on the left.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə lɔst ænd faʊnd ɑn ðə lɛft./
dialogue.zh: 失物招領，在左手邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's a clever system, you know.
dialogue.zh: 你們這系統真聰明。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We lose fewer umbrellas this way.
dialogue.zh: 這樣傘就比較不會不見。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many have you lost so far?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni hæv ju lɔst soʊ fɑr./
dialogue.zh: 到目前為止你丟了幾把？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four, in one very windy month.
dialogue.zh: 四把，就在一個超會颳風的月份。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four umbrellas is real money.
dialogue.zh: 四把傘也是真的錢耶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A wet rider costs more, trust me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə wɛt ˈraɪdər kɔsts mɔr trʌst mi./
dialogue.zh: 乘客淋濕的代價更高，信我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So who do you tip yourself?
dialogue.zh: 那你自己會給誰小費？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The parking guy, every single day.
dialogue.zh: 停車場管理員，我每天都給。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What does he do for you?
dialogue.zh: 他幫你做什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He saves me a walk in wind.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi seɪvz mi ə wɔk ɪn wɪnd./
dialogue.zh: 他讓我在風裡少走一段路。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do drivers tip other staff, then?
dialogue.zh: 那司機也會給其他員工小費嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nina does, she tips the doorman.
dialogue.zh: 妮娜會，她都給大樓門房。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You know Nina? For real?
dialogue.zh: 你認識妮娜？真的假的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We share a charging spot downtown.
dialogue.zh: 我們共用市區一個充電位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Small world. She saved my dinner.
dialogue.zh: 世界真小，她救過我的晚餐。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She's good like that, rain or not.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃiz ɡʊd laɪk ðæt reɪn ɔr nɑt./
dialogue.zh: 她就是這種人，下不下雨都一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell her I sent a big one.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl hɜr aɪ sɛnt ə bɪɡ wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 幫我告訴她我給了很大額。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll tell her, she'll laugh hard.
dialogue.zh: 我會說，她會大笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One last thing, my trip receipt.
dialogue.zh: 最後一件事，我這趟的收據。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's in the app, tap your profile.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ɪn ði æp tæp jɔr ˈproʊˌfaɪl./
dialogue.zh: 在軟體裡，點你的個人頁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Found it. Eighteen fifty, plus toll?
dialogue.zh: 找到了。十八塊五，再加過路費？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eighteen fifty, and two for toll.
dialogue.zh: 十八塊五，過路費兩塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So twenty is the number, then.
dialogue.zh: 那總共就是二十塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You did that math out loud.
dialogue.zh: 你剛剛還算出聲了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So four dollars, right on the dot.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ fɔr ˈdɑlərz raɪt ɑn ðə dɑt./
dialogue.zh: 那就是四塊，剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four? Ben, that's above my average.
dialogue.zh: 四塊？班，那比我平均還高。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I write a line, too?
dialogue.zh: 我也要寫一行評語嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write that the car was warm and dry.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ðæt ðə kɑr wʌz wɔrm ænd draɪ./
dialogue.zh: 就寫車裡又暖又乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Warm, dry, and one umbrella.
dialogue.zh: 暖、乾，還有一把傘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect. Now run, you'll miss it.
dialogue.zh: 完美。現在快跑，你要誤車了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for waiting while I paid.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你等我付完錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the job. Go, it's pouring.
dialogue.zh: 這是工作啦，快走，雨超大雨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, do you work here?
dialogue.zh: 打擾一下，妳是在這裡工作的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eighth floor is mine, starting now.
dialogue.zh: 八樓都是我負責，現在開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You clean this whole floor alone?
dialogue.zh: 這一整層都是你一個人在打掃？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two floors, but only on weekdays.
dialogue.zh: 兩層，不過只有平日。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's a lot of rooms for one person.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ə lɑt ʌv rumz fər wʌn ˈpɜrsən./
dialogue.zh: 一個人要弄這麼多間房耶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty, and I like the quiet.
dialogue.zh: 二十間，而且我喜歡安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I ask you about money?
dialogue.zh: 我可以問你錢的事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: If it's about the tip, sure.
dialogue.zh: 如果是小費，你問吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much per night is normal here?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ pər naɪt ɪz ˈnɔrməl hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 在這裡一晚給多少算正常？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five, and five more for a mess.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv ænd faɪv mɔr fər ə mɛs./
dialogue.zh: 五塊，如果很亂就再加五塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five for one night, every night?
dialogue.zh: 一晚五塊，每晚都要？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, per night, not per stay.
dialogue.zh: 對，一晚一算，不是一次付清。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So three nights is fifteen, right?
dialogue.zh: 那三晚就是十五塊，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: If the room stays normal, yes.
dialogue.zh: 只要房間不會太亂，就是這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What counts as a very messy room?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt kaʊnts æz ə ˈvɛri ˈmɛsi rum./
dialogue.zh: 什麼樣的情況算很亂？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The trash can tells me all.
dialogue.zh: 垃圾桶會告訴我一切。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine will be two cups a day.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn wɪl bi tu kʌps ə deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我的應該是一天兩個杯子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two cups? That's an easy room.
dialogue.zh: 兩個杯子？那是很好清的房間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I have to write a note?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ hæv tə raɪt ə noʊt./
dialogue.zh: 我非寫張字條不可嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, but notes are very kind.
dialogue.zh: 不用，但字條很暖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What should the note say, though?
dialogue.zh: 那字條上該寫什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you works, in any language.
dialogue.zh: 寫謝謝就行，任何語言都可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I leave it, the pillow?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du aɪ liv ɪt ðə ˈpɪloʊ./
dialogue.zh: 錢要放哪裡，枕頭上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The desk is better, please.
dialogue.zh: 請放書桌，那裡比較好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is the desk better for you?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ ɪz ðə dɛsk ˈbɛtər fər ju./
dialogue.zh: 為什麼放書桌對你比較好？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On the pillow, it looks like lost money.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ðə ˈpɪloʊ ɪt lʊks laɪk lɔst ˈmʌni./
dialogue.zh: 放在枕頭上像掉出來的錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lost money? Does that happen often?
dialogue.zh: 像掉錢？這種事常發生嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twice a week, someone calls us.
dialogue.zh: 一週兩次，會有人打電話來問。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So you give the money back?
dialogue.zh: 所以你們會把錢退回去？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I hand it to the front desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hænd ɪt tə ðə frʌnt dɛsk./
dialogue.zh: 我會直接交給櫃台。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then a note fixes that problem.
dialogue.zh: 那寫字條就能避開這個問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A note, and a folded bill.
dialogue.zh: 一張字條，再把鈔票折好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the desk sell envelopes here?
dialogue.zh: 櫃台有賣信封嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They give them, free, just ask.
dialogue.zh: 他們會白送你，問一下就有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One with my room number on it?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn wɪð maɪ rum ˈnʌmbər ɑn ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 上面寫我房間號碼的那種？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They write it, you add money.
dialogue.zh: 他們寫號碼，你放錢進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That beats the pillow, then.
dialogue.zh: 那真的比枕頭好多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's also safe when I'm slow.
dialogue.zh: 我動作慢的時候它也很安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Safe? What do you mean by safe?
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪf wʌt du ju min baɪ seɪf./
dialogue.zh: 安全？你說的安全是什麼意思？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nobody takes an envelope with a name.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊbədi teɪks ən ˈɑnvəˌloʊ wɪð ə neɪm./
dialogue.zh: 寫了名字的信，沒人會拿走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's a good reason to use one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ə ɡʊd ˈrizən tə juz wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 這理由讓我願意用信封。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use two, if you stay four nights.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz tu ɪf ju steɪ fɔr naɪts./
dialogue.zh: 如果你住四晚，就用兩個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Extra towels change the amount, though?
dialogue.zh: 多要毛巾會影響金額嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if I carry them upstairs.
dialogue.zh: 只有我要搬上樓的時候。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You bring towels up by hand?
dialogue.zh: 毛巾都是你用手提上來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: From the cart, yes, ten pounds.
dialogue.zh: 從推車拿，對，十磅重。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I'll add two for the towels.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪl æd tu fər ðə ˈtaʊəlz./
dialogue.zh: 那我為了毛巾多放兩塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You don't have to, but thanks.
dialogue.zh: 你不用這樣，但謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing, the late checkout.
dialogue.zh: 還有一件事，晚點退房。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I still clean, just later.
dialogue.zh: 我還是會清，只是晚一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the same amount, just later?
dialogue.zh: 那金額一樣，只是時間晚？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same amount, same thank you.
dialogue.zh: 金額一樣，謝謝也一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I empty my own trash?
dialogue.zh: 我自己的垃圾要倒嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please, the coffee cups stack high.
dialogue.zh: 拜託，咖啡杯會堆很高。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll stack them in the sink.
dialogue.zh: 我把它們疊在洗碗槽裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That helps more than money does.
dialogue.zh: 那個比錢還有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Money helps more, I would think.
dialogue.zh: 我覺得錢比較有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both help, and the stack is free.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ hɛlp ænd ðə stæk ɪs fri./
dialogue.zh: 兩個都有用，而且疊杯子不用錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There's a sign about tips downstairs.
dialogue.zh: 樓下有一張關於小費的告示。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Some hotels say no cash at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /sʌm hoʊˈtɛlz seɪ noʊ kæʃ ət ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 有些飯店完全不收現金。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does that rule apply to this hotel?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðæt rul əˈplaɪ tə ðɪs hoʊˈtɛl./
dialogue.zh: 那條規矩適用於這裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, our rule allows a note.
dialogue.zh: 不會，我們的規矩允許留字條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then why is that sign there?
dialogue.zh: 那張告示為什麼掛在那？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That sign is for the big tour groups.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt saɪn ɪz fər ðə bɪɡ tʊr ɡrupz./
dialogue.zh: 那張告示是貼給大團看的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The tour groups? What do they do?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tʊr ɡrupz wʌt du ðeɪ du./
dialogue.zh: 旅行團？他們會怎麼做？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One envelope for ten rooms, shared.
dialogue.zh: 十間房共用一個信封。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that better or worse for you?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt ˈbɛtər ɔr wɜrs fər ju./
dialogue.zh: 那對你是比較好還是比較差？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Worse for me, better for the team.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɜrs fər mi ˈbɛtər fər ðə tim./
dialogue.zh: 我虧一點，團隊划算。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a team jar in this hotel?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə tim dʒɑr ɪn ðɪs hoʊˈtɛl./
dialogue.zh: 你們飯店有團隊的罐子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one jar at the front desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wʌn dʒɑr æt ðə frʌnt dɛsk./
dialogue.zh: 有，櫃台那邊有一個罐子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So my cash can go in that jar.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ maɪ kæʃ kæn ɡoʊ ɪn ðæt dʒɑr./
dialogue.zh: 那我的現金可以放進那個罐子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That jar is for the night crew.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt dʒɑr ɪz fər ðə naɪt kru./
dialogue.zh: 那個罐子是給夜班那組的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about the man with my bags?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt əˈbaʊt ðə mæn wɪð maɪ bæɡz./
dialogue.zh: 那幫我提行李的人呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One dollar per bag, that's usual.
dialogue.zh: 一件行李一塊，這是慣例。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He carried one small case only.
dialogue.zh: 他只提了一個小箱子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then two, he waited in rain.
dialogue.zh: 那就給兩塊，他還在雨裡等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The parking person fetched my car.
dialogue.zh: 停車代管幫我把車開出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Valet gets two, or five in snow.
dialogue.phonetic: /væˈleɪ ɡɛts tu ɔr faɪv ɪn snoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 代客泊車給兩塊，下雪就五塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Snow five? That's a big jump.
dialogue.zh: 下雪五塊？這差很多耶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cold hands deserve a bigger number.
dialogue.zh: 凍著的手值得高一點的數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the shuttle driver get tips?
dialogue.zh: 接駁車司機要收小費嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only when he helps with a chair.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli wɛn hi hɛlps wɪð ə tʃɛr./
dialogue.zh: 只有他幫輪椅的時候。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A chair, like for a grandparent?
dialogue.zh: 輪椅？像是長輩用的那種？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the airport runs are heavy.
dialogue.zh: 對，跑機場那幾趟很重。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Morning! Did you find my envelope?
dialogue.zh: 早安！你有看到我的信封嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You left two, with a nice line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju lɛft tu wɪð ə naɪs laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 你留了兩個，上面寫了漂亮的話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The one about the coffee cups?
dialogue.zh: 是那個提到咖啡杯的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one. The team read it twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌn ðə tim rɛd ɪt twaɪs./
dialogue.zh: 對那個，大家讀了兩遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I only wrote that you work hard.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈoʊnli roʊt ðæt ju wɜrk hɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 我只寫了你工作很認真。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: People rarely write that, so it stays.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpipəl ˈrɛrli raɪt ðæt soʊ ɪt steɪz./
dialogue.zh: 很少有人這樣寫，所以我留著了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you keep those notes at home?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju kip ðoʊz noʊts æt hoʊm./
dialogue.zh: 這些字條你都留在家裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I keep them in a shoebox.
dialogue.zh: 我都收在一個鞋盒裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many notes in that box?
dialogue.zh: 那個盒子裡有幾張？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fourteen, in nine years of work.
dialogue.zh: 十四張，九年工作留下的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's one note every eight months.
dialogue.zh: 那八個月才有一張耶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One good one, yes, that's the rate.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ɡʊd wʌn jɛs ðæts ðə reɪt./
dialogue.zh: 一張好的，對，就是這個頻率。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Checkout time, so here's my last five.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtʃɛkˌaʊt taɪm soʊ hɪrz maɪ læst faɪv./
dialogue.zh: 退房了，這是最後一晚的五塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The jar is right beside the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə dʒɑr ɪz raɪt bəˈsaɪd ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 罐子就在門旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dropped. I have a haircut today.
dialogue.zh: 放好了，我今天還要剪頭髮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The shop on Third? My cousin works there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ʃɑp ɑn θɜrd maɪ ˈkʌzən wɜrks ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 是三元街那間嗎？我表姐在裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, nine fifteen appointment, Ben.
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我預約九點十五，班。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I'm Dana. Take this chair.
dialogue.zh: 對，我是妲娜，坐這張椅子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your cousin at the hotel sent me.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr ˈkʌzən æt ðə hoʊˈtɛl sɛnt mi./
dialogue.zh: 是飯店那位表姐介紹我來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What? My cousin works the third floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt maɪ ˈkʌzən wɜrks ðə θɜrd flɔr./
dialogue.zh: 不會吧？我表姐在三樓打掃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She said to tip this shop well.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi sɛd tə tɪp ðɪs ʃɑp wɛl./
dialogue.zh: 她說這家店要多給一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She also said I talk too much.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi ˈɔlsoʊ sɛd aɪ tɔk tu mʌtʃ./
dialogue.zh: 她也說我太愛講話了吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I sit here with my coat on?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ sɪt hɪr wɪð maɪ koʊt ɑn./
dialogue.zh: 我穿著外套坐這裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take it off, the cape is thick.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ɪt ɔf ðə keɪp ɪz θɪk./
dialogue.zh: 先脫掉，圍布很厚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This cape is heavier than a blanket.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs keɪp ɪz ˈhɛviər ðæn ə ˈblæŋkɪt./
dialogue.zh: 這塊圍布比毯子還重。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It keeps the hair off your shirt.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt kips ðə hɛr ɔf jɔr ʃɜrt./
dialogue.zh: 這樣頭髮就不會掉進衣服。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, I'm wearing a gray shirt.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我今天穿灰色上衣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we'll be careful, promise.
dialogue.zh: 那我們會很小心，我保證。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just the sides and the back today.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ðə saɪdz ænd ðə bæk təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 今天就修兩邊和後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shorter on the sides, how short?
dialogue.zh: 兩邊比較短，要多短？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One number, the one on the card.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈnʌmbər ði wʌn ɑn ðə kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 一個數字，就是卡片上那個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Number four, on the clipper.
dialogue.zh: 推剪的四號刻度，對了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes. And wash it first, please.
dialogue.zh: 對，先幫我洗頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mia will do that, she's right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmiə wɪl du ðæt ʃiz raɪt hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 米雅會洗，她就在旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi Mia. Do I lean back now?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ˈmiə du aɪ lin bæk naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 嗨，米雅。我現在往後躺？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and close your eyes, relax.
dialogue.zh: 對，閉上眼睛，放鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That water was the right temperature.
dialogue.zh: 水溫剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I do it twice for gray shirts.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ du ɪt twaɪs fər ɡreɪ ʃɜrts./
dialogue.zh: 穿灰衣的話我會洗兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You two talk while you work?
dialogue.zh: 你們兩個邊工作邊聊天？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We do, it's a long chair.
dialogue.zh: 會呀，這張椅子要坐很久。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long is my cut today?
dialogue.zh: 今天我這顆頭要多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty minutes, then color if you want.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnəts ðɛn ˈkʌlər ɪf ju wɑnt./
dialogue.zh: 二十分鐘，之後看你要不要染。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Color? I only booked a cut.
dialogue.zh: 染？我只預約了剪。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A slot opened, so I asked.
dialogue.zh: 剛好有空檔，我才問一聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No color today. One gray shirt.
dialogue.zh: 今天不染，我穿灰衣服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair, we'll just do the cut then.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛr wil dʒʌst du ðə kʌt ðɛn./
dialogue.zh: 合理，那我們就專心剪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So Mia does all the washing?
dialogue.zh: 所以洗頭都交給米雅？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mia, that's her station, her water.
dialogue.zh: 米雅，那是她的位置、她調水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is she paid less for that job?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ʃi peɪd lɛs fər ðæt dʒɑb./
dialogue.zh: 她做這個薪水比較低嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, but she's still learning, too.
dialogue.zh: 不會，但她還在學手藝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Learning, but she did a great job.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɜrnɪŋ bʌt ʃi dɪd ə ɡreɪt dʒɑb./
dialogue.zh: 在學，但她洗得很舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell her that, she'll remember it.
dialogue.zh: 你這樣告訴她，她會記很久。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here's the bill. What is this line?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪrz ðə bɪl wʌt ɪz ðɪs laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 帳單來了，這行是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The service charge? That's the shop's.
dialogue.zh: 服務費那一行？那是店裡的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It says eight point five percent.
dialogue.zh: 它寫百分之八點五。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it's added to every chair.
dialogue.zh: 對，每一張椅子都會加。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does that count as my tip?
dialogue.zh: 那筆算不算我給的小費？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, that one goes to the shop.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ðæt wʌn ɡoʊz tə ðə ʃɑp./
dialogue.zh: 不是，那筆是店收的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I ask you something honest?
dialogue.zh: 我可以問你一個老實的問題嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask, I like honest customers.
dialogue.zh: 問吧，我喜歡老實的客人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does anyone read this paper closely?
dialogue.zh: 有人會仔細看這張紙嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A few do, most just sign.
dialogue.zh: 少數人會，多數人直接簽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm the close reader, sorry.
dialogue.zh: 我就是會看很久的那種，抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, I'd rather explain it once.
dialogue.zh: 很好，我寧可一次講清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: If I keep my tip separate, though?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ kip maɪ tɪp ˈsɛpərət ðoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 那如果我的小費另外算呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the shop fee stays the same.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə ʃɑp fi steɪz ðə seɪm./
dialogue.zh: 那店裡的服務費也不會變。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And that fee doesn't come to you?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðæt fi ˈdʌzənt kʌm tə ju./
dialogue.zh: 那筆費也不會進你口袋？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Part of it, but not all of it.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɑrt ʌv ɪt bʌt nɑt ɔl ʌv ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 會進一部分，但不全部。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What part comes to you, then?
dialogue.zh: 那哪一部分是你的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The part called the staff pool.
dialogue.zh: 叫作員工公池的那部分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
