dialogue.text: So you see the pool on Friday?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ju si ðə pul ɑn ˈfraɪdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 所以你們週五才會看到錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every Friday, with the sales sheet.
dialogue.zh: 每週五，連業績表一起。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The machine wants a tip now, too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə məˈʃin wɑnts ə tɪp naʊ tu./
dialogue.zh: 這台機器現在也在要小費。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one is only for me.
dialogue.zh: 那個選項才是給我的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I tip on the full total?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ tɪp ɑn ðə fʊl ˈtoʊtəl./
dialogue.zh: 我要用含稅總額來算嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On the price before the tax, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ðə praɪs bɪˈfɔr ðə tæks pliz./
dialogue.zh: 請用稅前金額算就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Before tax. That's twenty, plus the fee.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪˈfɔr tæks ðæts ˈtwɛnti plʌs ðə fi./
dialogue.zh: 稅前是二十，再加那筆費。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, then twenty percent is four.
dialogue.zh: 對，二十塊的百分之二十是四塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: All in, it's about twenty-seven.
dialogue.zh: 全部加起來大約二十七塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's a big number for one head.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ə bɪɡ ˈnʌmbər fər wʌn hɛd./
dialogue.zh: 對一顆頭來說數字不小。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I skip you, then?
dialogue.zh: 那我是不是可以跳過你？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, skip the shop, not me.
dialogue.zh: 不，跳過店的，別跳過我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's a funny way to say it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ə ˈfʌni weɪ tə seɪ ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 這說法真有趣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's how our regulars phrase it.
dialogue.zh: 我們的老客人都是這樣講的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if I hate the haircut?
dialogue.zh: 如果我回家討厭這個頭髮呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then come back, I fix it free.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn kʌm bæk aɪ fɪks ɪt fri./
dialogue.zh: 那就回來，我免費幫你修整。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And on the fix day, do I tip?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɑn ðə fɪks deɪ du aɪ tɪp./
dialogue.zh: 那來修整那天還要給錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tip the wash, not the fix.
dialogue.zh: 給洗頭的就好，修整不用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mia again, so five goes to her.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmiə əˈɡɛn soʊ faɪv ɡoʊz tə hɜr./
dialogue.zh: 又是米雅洗，那五塊給她。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She'd be happy with three.
dialogue.zh: 三塊她就很開心了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here's five, and it's for Mia.
dialogue.zh: 這是五塊，特別給米雅的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can hand it, or use this.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn hænd ɪt ɔr juz ðɪs./
dialogue.zh: 你可以親手給她，或放這個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This envelope at your station?
dialogue.zh: 放在她位置旁邊的信封？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we label them with names.
dialogue.zh: 對，我們會在信封寫名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cool. What about holiday money?
dialogue.zh: 好。那過年過節的呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In December, we get bigger notes.
dialogue.zh: 十二月的時候，大家都會多給。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bigger like double, or more?
dialogue.zh: 多到像兩倍，還是更多？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Depends on the guest, some give fifty.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪˈpɛndz ɑn ðə ɡɛst sʌm ɡɪv ˈfɪfti./
dialogue.zh: 看客人，有人會給五十。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fifty for a cut? That's my week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɪfti fər ə kʌt ðæts maɪ wik./
dialogue.zh: 剪一顆頭五十？那是我一周的錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The weekly ones, mostly, yeah.
dialogue.zh: 大部分是每週都來的客人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm not weekly. I'm the gray shirt.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm nɑt ˈwikli aɪm ðə ɡreɪ ʃɜrt./
dialogue.zh: 我不是每週來的，我是灰衣服的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're a good Tuesday, Ben.
dialogue.zh: 你是很棒的星期二客人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's a title I'll take, thanks.
dialogue.zh: 這個稱號我收下了，謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write the number, then sign below.
dialogue.zh: 把數字寫下來，再簽下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four on the machine, plus Mia's five.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr ɑn ðə məˈʃin plʌs ˈmiəz faɪv./
dialogue.zh: 機器上按四塊，再加米雅那五塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's a fair night for us.
dialogue.zh: 對我們來說是公道的夜晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the fee and the tip are separate.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə fi ænd ðə tɪp ɑr ˈsɛpərət./
dialogue.zh: 所以那筆費和小費是兩回事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One feeds the shop, one feeds me.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn fidz ðə ʃɑp wʌn fidz mi./
dialogue.zh: 一個餵店，一個餵我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mia's envelope, and your chair tip.
dialogue.zh: 米雅的信封，還有你的椅子費。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now look up in the mirror.
dialogue.zh: 現在抬頭看看鏡子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, that's my hair, I think.
dialogue.zh: 哇，這應該是我的頭髮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The gray shirt survived, congrats.
dialogue.zh: 灰衣服平安無事，恭喜你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My friend never tips at salons.
dialogue.zh: 我朋友在理髮店從不給小費。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring her Saturday, the chair is open.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ hɜr ˈsætərˌdeɪ ðə tʃɛr ɪz ˈoʊpən./
dialogue.zh: 週六帶她來，椅子有空。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saturday morning, then. What time?
dialogue.zh: 那就週六早上，幾點？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine sharp, and bring small bills.
dialogue.zh: 九點整，帶一些小鈔來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same table by the window today?
dialogue.zh: 今天還坐窗邊那張？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and two coffees, my treat.
dialogue.zh: 對，兩杯咖啡，我請客。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your treat? Then I'll sit and watch.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr trit ðɛn aɪl sɪt ænd wɑtʃ./
dialogue.zh: 你請？那我就坐著看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You paid the last three rounds.
dialogue.zh: 前三輪都是你付的呀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here, let me open my notebook.
dialogue.zh: 來，我把筆記本打開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You carry a real notebook? Wow.
dialogue.zh: 你帶真的紙本筆記？哇。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Page six, all my numbers.
dialogue.zh: 第六頁，全是我給的數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Read one, I want to hear yours.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɛd wʌn aɪ wɑnt tə hɪr jʊrz./
dialogue.zh: 念一個給我聽，我想看你的習慣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Coffee, one dollar each morning.
dialogue.zh: 咖啡，每天早上給一塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's more than my jar budget.
dialogue.zh: 那超過我罐子的預算。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Jar? You have a jar budget?
dialogue.zh: 罐子？你幫罐子設預算？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Coins only, five a week.
dialogue.zh: 只丟銅板，一週五塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, mine is twenty in bills.
dialogue.zh: 好，我是二十塊鈔票。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty! That's a real number.
dialogue.zh: 二十！那才是有感的數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Delivery is the expensive one.
dialogue.zh: 外送才是最貴的一項。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I gave the driver nothing last night.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ɡeɪv ðə ˈdraɪvər ˈnʌθɪŋ læst naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我昨晚沒給司機任何錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nothing? In this weather?
dialogue.zh: 半毛沒有？這種天氣耶？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No cash, and then I forgot.
dialogue.zh: 家裡沒現金，後來又忘了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You can fix it in the app.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn fɪks ɪt ɪn ði æp./
dialogue.zh: 你可以在軟體裡補回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's been a day. Too late?
dialogue.zh: 已經過一天了，太慢了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, it stays open for days.
dialogue.zh: 不會，那欄會留好幾天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Show me then, my thumbs hate this.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃoʊ mi ðɛn maɪ θʌmz heɪt ðɪs./
dialogue.zh: 那你教我，我的拇指很討厭操作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There. Order, then edit, then ten.
dialogue.zh: 這裡，點訂單，編輯，輸入十。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten dollars for one soup?
dialogue.zh: 一碗湯給十塊？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My driver's Nina. Six floors, no lift.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈdraɪvərz ˈninə sɪks flɔrz noʊ lɪft./
dialogue.zh: 我的司機是妮娜，六樓沒電梯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, that changes the math.
dialogue.zh: 好啦，那數學就不一樣了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See? My rideshare was four.
dialogue.zh: 看吧？我搭車給四塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four is a big tip already.
dialogue.zh: 四塊已經算很大方了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The driver said it's above her average.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈdraɪvər sɛd ɪts əˈbʌv hɜr ˈævərədʒ./
dialogue.zh: 那個司機說比她的平均還高。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Drivers say that to everyone.
dialogue.zh: 司機對每個人都這樣講啦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hotel room, five dollars a day.
dialogue.zh: 飯店房間，一天五塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I do ten, plus a folded note.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ du tɛn plʌs ə ˈfoʊldəd noʊt./
dialogue.zh: 我都給十塊，再加一張字條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A note? What do you write?
dialogue.zh: 字條？你都寫什麼內容？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, and sorry about the mess.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju ænd ˈsɑri əˈbaʊt ðə mɛs./
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，還有抱歉房間很亂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry about the mess? Every time?
dialogue.zh: 抱歉很亂？每次都道歉？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every time, I always make a mess.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvri taɪm aɪ ˈɔlweɪz meɪk ə mɛs./
dialogue.zh: 每次都寫，我本來就很會製造混亂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's honest. Fifteen, plus two for towels.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ˈɑnəst fɪfˈtin plʌs tu fər ˈtaʊəlz./
dialogue.zh: 那很誠實。十五塊，再加兩塊毛巾錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three nights? That's fair.
dialogue.zh: 三晚嗎？那很公道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Salon was the confusing one.
dialogue.zh: 沙龍那單最讓人困惑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They add a fee, right? I hate that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ æd ə fi raɪt aɪ heɪt ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 他們會加收一筆費，對吧？我討厭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eight point five on the paper.
dialogue.zh: 單子上寫八點五。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And then the machine asks again.
dialogue.zh: 然後機器又問你一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I paid four, plus five in cash.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ peɪd fɔr plʌs faɪv ɪn kæʃ./
dialogue.zh: 我按了四塊，另外給五塊現金。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five in cash for who, exactly?
dialogue.zh: 那五塊現金是給誰的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The girl who washed my hair.
dialogue.zh: 幫我洗頭的那個女孩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the correct person, yes.
dialogue.zh: 那給對人了，沒錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You know this. Where did you learn?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju noʊ ðɪs wɛr dɪd ju lɜrn./
dialogue.zh: 你很懂耶，在哪裡學的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I worked in a salon at nineteen.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɜrkt ɪn ə səˈlɑn æt ˌnaɪnˈtin./
dialogue.zh: 我十九歲在沙龍工作過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You? In a salon? For how long?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɪn ə səˈlɑn fər haʊ lɔŋ./
dialogue.zh: 你？在沙龍？多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two years, and I cut my brother's hair.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu jɪrz ænd aɪ kʌt maɪ ˈbrʌðərz hɛr./
dialogue.zh: 做了兩年，我還會幫弟弟剪頭髮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That explains the good haircut.
dialogue.zh: 難怪我頭髮剪得不錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It explains the math, at least.
dialogue.zh: 至少那解釋了數學。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's compare the week's total.
dialogue.zh: 來比一比這週的總額。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine is around eighty dollars.
dialogue.zh: 我大約八十塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eighty! Mine is one twenty.
dialogue.zh: 八十！我一百二十。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One twenty? You're rich in tips.
dialogue.zh: 一百二？你在小費界很有錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm not rich, I'm bad at rounding.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm nɑt rɪtʃ aɪm bæd æt ˈraʊndɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 我不是有錢，我只是不會進位。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same, but the other direction.
dialogue.zh: 我也是，只是往反方向。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bad service, do you still tip?
dialogue.zh: 服務很差的話你還給嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I tip half, and I say why.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ tɪp hæf ænd aɪ seɪ waɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我給一半，然後說出原因。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You say why? Out loud?
dialogue.zh: 你會講出來？當面？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Politely, once, at the counter.
dialogue.zh: 很有禮貌地，在櫃台說一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can't do that, I just pay.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kænt du ðæt aɪ dʒʌst peɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我做不到，我只會付錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then tip less, and sleep fine.
dialogue.zh: 那就少給一點，睡得香。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The self-checkout bagger, though?
dialogue.zh: 那自助結帳幫忙裝袋的人呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No tip, but I say his name.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ tɪp bʌt aɪ seɪ hɪz neɪm./
dialogue.zh: 不用給錢，但我會叫他的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's cheap and kind, I like it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts tʃip ænd kaɪnd aɪ laɪk ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 既不花錢又貼心，我喜歡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Free things count, in my book.
dialogue.zh: 不花錢的善意也算數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The movers next week, how much?
dialogue.zh: 下週搬運費要給多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty each, plus water and pizza.
dialogue.zh: 每人二十，再加礦泉水和披薩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pizza? That's a real strategy.
dialogue.zh: 披薩？這招很實際耶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's the cheapest raise I know.
dialogue.zh: 那是我所知道最便宜的加薪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The repairman is waiting today.
dialogue.zh: 修東西的師傅今天在等。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten, or nothing if it's quick.
dialogue.zh: 十塊，如果很快就不用給。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nothing? He came in from the rain.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌθɪŋ hi keɪm ɪn frʌm ðə reɪn./
dialogue.zh: 不給？他是從雨裡進來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then ten, and I'll write the note.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn tɛn ænd aɪl raɪt ðə noʊt./
dialogue.zh: 那就十塊，我來寫字條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The dog walker gets what?
dialogue.zh: 遛狗的領幾塊？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five, and one extra at Christmas.
dialogue.zh: 五塊，聖誕節再多給一份。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Christmas is the expensive month.
dialogue.zh: 聖誕節是最貴的月份。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Envelopes for six people, here.
dialogue.zh: 我這裡要準備六個信封。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six people? Tell me who.
dialogue.zh: 六個人？說是誰。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Doorman, cleaner, walker, driver, stylist, mail person.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdɔrˌmæn ˈklɪnər ˈwɔkər ˈdraɪvər ˈstaɪlɪst meɪl ˈpɜrsən./
dialogue.zh: 門房、清潔、遛狗、司機、髮型師、郵差。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The mail person? Really?
dialogue.zh: 郵差？真的要給？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She saves my boxes from rain.
dialogue.zh: 她會幫我的紙箱擋雨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, that one I'll copy.
dialogue.zh: 好，這點我跟你學。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Copy it, it's five dollars.
dialogue.zh: 抄去吧，那只要五塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: At home we don't tip anyone.
dialogue.zh: 在我們家鄉，沒人收小費。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At home you also get bigger portions.
dialogue.phonetic: /æt hoʊm ju ˈɔlsoʊ ɡɛt ˈbɪɡər ˈpɔrʃənz./
dialogue.zh: 在那邊餐點份量也比較大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: True. My mother never tips anyone.
dialogue.zh: 對，我媽從不給小費。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine says the price should include it.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn sɛz ðə praɪs ʃʊd ɪnˈklud ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我媽說價錢就該含在裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So we're both confused here.
dialogue.zh: 所以我們兩個在這兒都很困惑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Confused, but on purpose, I think.
dialogue.zh: 是困惑，但我們是故意的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's make one rule for us.
dialogue.zh: 來定一條我們自己的規矩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One: twenty on a good day.
dialogue.zh: 第一，事情順利就給百分之二十。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two: cash if there's a jar.
dialogue.zh: 第二，有罐子就給現金。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three: never hold up the line.
dialogue.zh: 第三，別讓後面的人等你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deal. I'll write it on page six.
dialogue.phonetic: /dil aɪl raɪt ɪt ɑn peɪdʒ sɪks./
dialogue.zh: 成交，我寫在第六頁。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Come on, the jar is by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌm ɑn ðə dʒɑr ɪz baɪ ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 走吧，罐子就在門口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two bills, and see you tomorrow?
dialogue.zh: 放兩張紙幣，明天見？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same jar, same rule, same tip button.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm dʒɑr seɪm rul seɪm tɪp ˈbʌtən./
dialogue.zh: 一樣的罐子，一樣的規矩，一樣的按鈕。
